zh-CN.title: Niko 动起来了
items: Niko 招呼头像框加入挥手动画，小猫会从头像一角探出问候
Niko 巡游气泡加入环绕奔跑动画，并在四个方向自然切换动作
奔跑动效使用独立渲染层，不再干扰发送状态与气泡合并

en.title: Niko is now in motion
items: The Niko Hello avatar frame now features an animated greeting from the corner
The Niko Patrol bubble now runs around the message and changes direction at each corner
The runner uses an independent layer that preserves sending states and grouped corners
